'''Gar Granga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith]] member, who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Granga was a member of the [[Believers]] and in circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he conspired with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Kosa-Yin Hadu]] to try and kill the [[kaluthin]], a plant on [[Almas]] that made the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] habitable.

He later became one of the bodyguards of [[Garvin Delquist]], a former researcher who had gained control of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] through a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]].
